name: add_github_actions_ci_java
description: Adds a GitHub Actions CI workflow that builds the Maven project
prompts: Add a GitHub Actions CI workflow for this Maven project at .github/workflows/ci.yml. It must: trigger on both `push` and `pull_request` events targeting the `main` branch; run on `ubuntu-latest`; check out the repository (e.g. actions/checkout@v4); set up JDK 17 (e.g. actions/setup-java@v4 with distribution 'temurin' and java-version '17'); and run a Maven build/package step (e.g. `mvn -B -DskipTests package`).

test_setup_files.check_ci.py:
import re, sys

with open('.github/workflows/ci.yml', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    text = f.read()
low = text.lower()

checks = [
    ('on:' in low, 'missing a top-level "on:" trigger key'),
    ('push' in low, 'missing a push trigger'),
    ('pull_request' in low, 'missing a pull_request trigger'),
    ('main' in low, 'missing a reference to the main branch'),
    ('jobs:' in low, 'missing a jobs: key'),
    ('runs-on' in low, 'missing runs-on'),
    ('ubuntu' in low, 'missing an ubuntu runner'),
    (re.search(r'actions/checkout@v\d', low) is not None, 'missing an actions/checkout step'),
    (re.search(r'actions/setup-java@v\d', low) is not None, 'missing an actions/setup-java step'),
    ('17' in low, 'missing java 17 version'),
    (re.search(r'mvn\s+.*(package|install|test)', low) is not None, 'missing a maven build/test/package step'),
]

failed = [msg for ok, msg in checks if not ok]
if failed:
    for m in failed:
        print('FAIL:', m)
    sys.exit(1)
print('PASS')

reference_solution..github/workflows/ci.yml:
name: CI
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: '17'
      - run: mvn -B -DskipTests package
